trigger.discovery_chronology: Search discovery exposed the named programs and headline terms before this contract. To eliminate outcome selection, this contract freezes the complete official incentive-program page and jointly adjudicates Volume, Fill, and Deposit programs; no one program, market, category, pool, or favorable example may be selected after access.
trigger.distinctness: The consumed liquidity-incentive API source gate and the maker-rebate rounding identity do not test taker-volume share, filled-maker-volume share, or first-deposit credit rewards.

question: Do the current official Polymarket US incentive terms define open direction-independent Volume, Fill, and Deposit reward mechanisms with exact qualification and payment identities that can be admitted only on independently existing legitimate activity after every cost?

endpoint_classification.operation: download the complete public official Polymarket US incentive-program documentation page
endpoint_classification.security: public unauthenticated read-only documentation GET with no account credential order deposit or mutation semantics
endpoint_classification.source_contract: Only literal retained current terms may define program identity. Dated March examples cannot be treated as current pool inventory.

decision.volume_scope: Accept only exact positive owned reward actually credited from independently justified legitimate organic eligible taker flow after fee spread slippage adverse selection inventory hedge and every incremental cost. Public examples or pool shares prove no owned reward floor.
decision.fill_scope: Accept only exact positive owned weekly reward actually credited from independently justified legitimate organic resting maker fills after fee rebate spread queue adverse selection inventory hedge and every incremental cost. A published cap is not expected value.
decision.deposit_scope: Accept only exact positive owned incentive credit actually usable or withdrawable after an independently intended first deposit by a genuinely new eligible ISV-onboarded participant and every deposit withdrawal delay tax custody banking and operating cost. Never create duplicate or synthetic eligibility.
decision.current_pool_rule: The dated Week of March 14, 2026 table is historical unless a current exact program inventory independently proves otherwise. No current market or positive public payout floor may be inferred from it.
decision.stable_edge_rule: No program is stable or deployment-ready without exact current account eligibility, owned receipt, current pool or credit treatment, all costs, and prospective recurrence where applicable.

retry_policy: This exact documentation GET is one-use. Preserve any response or failure and do not retry an alias, regional page, dated pool, market, incentive API, account, earnings, deposit, or order route. Reopen only on a material official program, reward, eligibility, payment, API, or architecture change or with explicit separate read-only account authority for independently existing qualifying activity.
